facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation officially launched the national internet exchange centre (IXP) at International Mauritanian Telecommunications (IMT) on 2025-05-28 (document gives no city or member count), with a technical presentation of its operation by the head of the Digital Infrastructure Foundation, per Sahara Medias reporting the ministry.
facts.system: Centre national d'échange Internet (national IXP at IMT)

systems.system: Centre national d'échange Internet (national IXP at IMT)
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation; Digital Infrastructure Foundation; hosted at IMT

note: The only exchange point named (CENIX, January 2026) is in the Central African Republic; nothing on an exchange in MRT.
Names exchanges only in South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria; Mauritania appears only as a Starlink market scheduled for 2026.

facts.fact: The WARCIP-Mauritania feasibility study (consultants Marpij, Neo Telecoms, Eric Veve; final version, June 2014) states that Mauritania has no exchange point yet: operators' traffic to each other is transit, not local peering, and Dakar in effect acts as the IXP for Mauritanian operators, Mauritel and Chinguitel traffic being exchanged there; the study proposes creating one.

systems.system: Mauritania IXP (proposed, single site at the IMT ACE landing station in Nouakchott, second site later at the Nouakchott datacenter building)
systems.platform: Layer 2 switch cluster with route servers (scenarios studied)
systems.tiers: Mauritel, Mattel, Chinguitel as expected members

note: Design study of a planned IXP, none operating; the study also says global content networks (Google, Akamai, Amazon, OVH) are totally absent from Mauritania.

facts.fact: The ministry's representative says the National Internet Exchange Centre (IXP) was recently officially launched, as a local exchange platform to localise data traffic.
The Nouakchott Data Center is stated to provide a central data exchange point linking local and international ISPs and operators.
Agence Ecofin reports Mauritania put a new internet exchange point (IXP) into service during 2025.

note: No exchange point in this country stated.
